inspection.scope: Introduction colour/vector-like definition; full seven-multiplet list and electric charges in Section 2.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

locator.section_equations: Introduction; Section 2 Eq.(1) and paragraphs below

claims.value: Seven alternative colour-triplet vector-like quark multiplets, one at a time: T,B singlets; XT,TB,BY doublets; XTB,TBY triplets. Component charges X=5/3,T=2/3,B=-1/3,Y=-4/3 fix Y=Q-T3, yielding 2/3,-1/3,7/6,1/6,-5/6,2/3,-1/3 respectively. Each source Dirac multiplet expands to LH R plus LH conjugate R; do not count dimensions as copies.

value_status_policy.not_specified_by_source: only within identified inspected source scope

reconciliation_policy: Reuse/correct the known source-linked existing entry after review; no unmatched fingerprint is a novelty claim.
